topic: physical exercise as a treatment for depression

criteria.text: The study participants are adults (minimum age 18 years)
The participants have clinically significant depressive symptoms at enrolment
The intervention being tested is a structured physical exercise programme
The study randomly allocates participants to study groups

inclusion_rule: Include when the record is on topic, crit_3 and crit_4 are met, and neither crit_1 nor crit_2 fails (not_stated is acceptable for population and condition).
